title: Coordinates selected by positions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and let $P$ be a set of positions in its literal list. For any coordinate $i$, the coordinate $i$ occurs among the literals at positions in $P$ if and only if some position in $P$ contains a literal whose coordinate is $i$.
